name: the-quad-server
description: The Quad - EDUK8U x ICQA Alumni Network API server

scripts.reset: node -e "const {Pool}=require('pg');const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL,ssl:{rejectUnauthorized:false}});p.query('DROP TABLE IF EXISTS messages,mentorships,mentor_profiles,rsvps,events,listings,jobs,post_comments,post_likes,posts,connections,invites,users CASCADE').then(()=>{console.log('Tables dropped. They will be recreated (and reseeded) on next start.');p.end()})"
